rules.label: Response to a petition or objection (D.C. Probate)

authority.quote: A response must be filed within 14 days after the petition or objection is filed.
authority.note: Runs from the FILING of the petition or objection, not from service, so Rule 128(d) ("When a party may or must act within a specified time after being served ... 3 days are added") does not reach it. effective_from is the effective date of the compiled Probate Division rules (2022-08-22); the official Rules and Promulgation Orders list shows no later order amending the Probate Division rules.

authority.quote: Except as provided in Rule 112(c)(2), a fiduciary must file an inventory within 90 days after the court appointing the fiduciary or the date of a court order providing for continuing supervision of the administration of the estate or trust.
authority.note: The trigger is the appointment (or the order for continuing supervision, whichever applies to the matter: enter that date). Runs from the appointment, not from service, so Rule 128(d) ("When a party may or must act within a specified time after being served ... 3 days are added") does not reach it. effective_from is the effective date of the compiled Probate Division rules (2022-08-22); the official Rules and Promulgation Orders list shows no later order amending the Probate Division rules.

authority.quote: A conservator must file an inventory within 60 days after the court appointing the conservator.
authority.note: Runs from the appointment, not from service, so Rule 128(d) ("When a party may or must act within a specified time after being served ... 3 days are added") does not reach it. effective_from is the effective date of the compiled Probate Division rules (2022-08-22); the official Rules and Promulgation Orders list shows no later order amending the Probate Division rules.

rules.label: Demand for a formal audit of a final account after a waiver (D.C. Probate)

authority.quote: An heir or legatee who has signed a waiver of formal audit may require a formal audit by filing a written demand within 20 days after the approval of the supervised personal representative's final account.
authority.note: Rule 113(e) is WAIVER OF AUDIT OF ACCOUNT; (6)(B) is its decedent's-estate final-account paragraph. Runs from the approval of the final account, not from service, so Rule 128(d) ("When a party may or must act within a specified time after being served ... 3 days are added") does not reach it. effective_from is the effective date of the compiled Probate Division rules (2022-08-22); the official Rules and Promulgation Orders list shows no later order amending the Probate Division rules.

rules.label: Motion for reconsideration of an order approving a final account that disposed of an objection (D.C. Probate)

authority.quote: If the court disposes of an objection to a final account in a decedent's estate through an order approving the final account or an order entered contemporaneously with the court's approval of the account, a motion for reconsideration may be made no later than 20 days after the entry of the order approving the final account.
authority.note: Rule 125(c)(3): the court may not extend this time. Runs from ENTRY of the order, not from service, so Rule 128(d) ("When a party may or must act within a specified time after being served ... 3 days are added") does not reach it. effective_from is the effective date of the compiled Probate Division rules (2022-08-22); the official Rules and Promulgation Orders list shows no later order amending the Probate Division rules.
